transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… hi. I guess I’m here because I’ve just been feeling really low for a long time. Like, the last couple years, honestly. I still go to work and church and I’m around people I care about, so I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but there’s this kind of heavy, empty feeling that just… doesn’t really go away.
Has this low mood been present most of the time, like most of the day nearly every day, for the past couple of years?

Yeah… I think so. It’s been about two years and four months now, since I had to stop taking community-college classes because of money and my work schedule. I mean, some days I get through okay, so I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s been there most of the time for a long while.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or being with friends and family?

Yeah… I guess I have. I mean, I still care about people and I don’t want it to sound like I’ve just given up on everything, but I’ve mostly stopped going to things I used to really like — basketball, dance nights, and the STEM mentoring at church.

And work has been… not great. I’ve missed some shifts, and I’ve been late turning in inspection paperwork. I’ve actually gotten written warnings for it, which is embarrassing to say. I’m trying, but it’s like I don’t have the same interest or push to show up the way I used to.
Have you noticed that your mood has caused you problems in your daily life, like at work, in your relationships, or in your ability to take care of yourself?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say I’m completely falling apart or anything, but it has caused problems. At work I’ve gotten written warnings because I’ve missed shifts and turned in inspection documentation late, which I’m pretty embarrassed about.

And outside of work, I’ve mostly stopped showing up for things I used to care about, like basketball, dance nights, and the STEM mentoring at church. I know that probably sounds bad… I’m still trying, but it’s definitely affected my day-to-day life.
Have you had days when you didn't feel this low mood at all, or has it been pretty much constant over the past two years?

I mean… there might be little moments where I’m distracted or I’m laughing with someone, so I don’t want to say every single second. But honestly, for the last couple years it’s felt pretty constant. Even at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there’s still this heavy, empty feeling underneath that doesn’t really lift.
